Remember the first time you backed out of the driveway? That feeling was pure freedom. But for them, that moment could be one of the most terrifying of their lives. When you’re a teenager, they have absolutely no way of knowing if you’re speeding, where you went, when you arrived, or how safely you’re driving. “No news is good news”—they can only hope everything is fine until you check in.

If you have a teenager who drives now, you should really cherish this moment, because you no longer have to live in those worry-filled years. Although 2026 technology still has its shortcomings, HeyPolo is clearly a great example of how technology can make teenage driving safer and life better.

HeyPolo is more than just an enhanced version of Apple’s Find My feature

HeyPolo is a family safety app that bundles real-time location sharing, arrival and departure notifications, SOS emergency alerts, and driving safety features all into one price. And it’s the driving features that set it apart from regular location-sharing apps like Find My. Every time your kids get behind the wheel, their driving behaviour is tracked and scored so you can see exactly how they’re performing: how fast they’re going, whether they’re using their phone while driving, whether there are any hard brakes or sudden accelerations, and whether any serious driving incidents are detected.

The “Driving Score” rates every trip based on their actual driving behaviour, so you no longer have to guess whether your kids are really driving safely. You can look at the data, and if their driving isn’t great, you can have a serious talk with them, so they can improve their driving habits and the score will naturally improve over time. Compared to anything the previous generation had access to, this is far more useful for helping newly licensed drivers build their skills.

Crash detection, arrival notifications, and more

HeyPolo can detect crashes and automatically notify you. Add arrival notifications on top of that—whether your kids are going to school, practice, a friend’s house, or coming home, the system will send a triggered notification—turning “hoping no news is good news” into actually knowing if they’re safe. You don’t have to wait until they arrive before texting or calling them; you can know exactly when they arrive, and that peace of mind is priceless for parents. HeyPolo updates your location every 5 seconds, so your location information is always accurate.

One price, shared by the whole family

A single HeyPolo subscription already covers your entire family—absolutely no extra per-person fees. It also supports both iPhone and Android, so even if family members use different devices there’s nothing to worry about. HeyPolo is developed by the team behind Surfshark, so it has a solid privacy foundation. They won’t sell your data; you can control what you share, who you share it with, and when you stop sharing, and all data is automatically deleted every 7 days. For a location-based app, this kind of approach to privacy is absolutely essential.

HeyPolo offers a 30-day money-back guarantee, and there are no contracts to sign—there’s absolutely no reason not to give it a try.
